plainText:
Zirco (Japanese: ジル Zir) is a character who appears in Pokémon UNITE. He sells Holowear to s participating in Unite Battles.

==In the games==
Zirco manages Zirco Trading, a shop that specializes in the sale of Holowear. Unlike the other characters who work at the stores in , he is apathetic to the player's approach. Instead, he stares at his computer and some holograms of Aeos gems. He wears a shirt with a design reminiscent of Sableye's center gemstone and an Ultra Ball themed hoodie.

His partner Pokémon is . His Sableye is wearing Holowear styled after Zirco's own hoodie.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island!===
Zirco appeared in the second chapter, Zirco's Holowear, alongside Erbie. He created Holowear to add a fashion element to Unite Battles, inspired by Pokémon Contests, Pokémon Musicals, and the films produced by Pokéstar Studios. He called Erbie over to Zirco Trading to attempt to convince Eribie to approve of his addition. While Erbie disapproved, citing the possibility of affecting a Pokémon's performance, Zirco had a trick up his sleeve. He invited Erbie to touch his Sableye. Said Sableye was already wearing Holowear, and Erbie's hand phased right through. This served to demonstrate Holowear's holographic (and therefore, purely cosmetic) properties. Even though Erbie is unsure and defers to Professor Phorus, Zirco starts selling pre-orders for Holowear. When Erbie complained, Zirco taunted him by insisting that "everyone's having fun".

Zirco appeared in the third chapter, Welcome to the Stadium!. He called over a trainer and their father to Zirco Trading, and the two took a look at Zirco's wares. Ultimately, the trainer purchased Bedtime Style Holowear for their . Zirco waved as the daughter and father duo left his store.

====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Zirco was designed by Hitoshi Ariga.
